sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Preview Release, April 24, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated official announcement releases V4 Pro preview, publishes open weights, names deepseek-v4-pro, reports nominal 1.6T total/49B active and 1M context, and describes Thinking/Non-Thinking modes and agentic coding.

sources.title: Original DeepSeek-V4-Pro model card
sources.evidence: Identifies this repository as the V4 preview, with nominal 1.6T/49B MoE, CSA/HCA hybrid attention and mHC, advertised one-million-token context, three reasoning modes, agent benchmarks, and MIT coverage of repository and weights.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Causal language model with hidden size 7168, 61 main layers, one next-token prediction layer, 384 routed experts/top-6 plus one shared expert per block, three hash-routing layers, and 1048576 positional capacity; packed FP4 experts with mixed FP8 weights.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro reference inference model
sources.evidence: Defines the Transformer, hybrid attention, MoE and MTP modules. FP4 stores two weights per byte; quantization scales are representations. Hash routing tid2eid has requires_grad=False. mHC scales and router weights/biases are parameters. MTP shares the main embedding and output head explicitly.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro checkpoint conversion
sources.evidence: FP4 conversion explicitly doubles the packed input dimension and unpacks low/high nibbles. Conversion skips duplicated MTP embedding/head state. Supports the logical-weight interpretation independently of storage-element counts.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro weight index and all indexed shard headers
sources.evidence: Resolved index plus bounded HTTP Range reads of every one of its 64 shard headers at this revision account for all 145116 tensors. Logical total is 1598837347742: main 1572997201763 plus unique MTP 25840145979. Expanded 71424 FP4 tensors; excluded 49150268416 quantization-scale elements and 2327040 fixed routing-index entries. Retained 374 learned mHC scale values, 170655744 gate weights and 22656 gate biases. No full shard downloaded.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro MIT license
sources.evidence: Repository license is MIT, copyright DeepSeek; the exact model card explicitly applies it to the released weights.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4 prompt and tool-call encoding
sources.evidence: Exact repository documents text-message input/output, explicit reasoning blocks, three reasoning settings in combination with the card, and DSML tool invocation/response handling with OpenAI-compatible tool definitions.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
sources.evidence: Technical report explicitly concerns the preview. Pro setup specifies 61 Transformer blocks, 384 routed experts/top-6 plus one shared, MTP depth one, CSA/HCA and mHC, nominal 1.6T/49B. FP4 QAT quantizes FP32 master weights. Multimodal capabilities are identified as future work.

sources.title: DeepSeek current API model mapping
sources.evidence: Current deepseek-v4-pro API alias maps to DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813. This is later than the original preview checkpoint, so current alias specifications are not substituted into this April record.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release, August 13, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated GA announcement says API model names remain unchanged, establishing why the same API identifier must be distinguished from the April preview.

sources.title: Original DeepSeek-V4-Pro repository history
sources.evidence: Repository history identifies April 24 release commit 0e1a0e5 and latest June 22 technical-report update b5968e9, preceding the August GA revision. Pinned configuration and model card match the accessed main files.

name.note: Catalog display spelling of official DeepSeek-V4-Pro; this assessment preserves the April preview identity linked by the baseline, not the 0813 API alias target.

developer.note: Official DeepSeek announcement, organization-hosted checkpoint and DeepSeek-AI technical report identify the developer.

family.note: Retains the catalog grouping for DeepSeek reasoning models. The developer identifies the architectural generation as DeepSeek-V4 and supports thinking and non-thinking modes; the grouping is not a separate checkpoint name.

release_date.note: Explicit official preview-release date, corroborated by the named release commit. August 13 is a later GA revision using the same API model name.

open_weights.note: Officially released, publicly accessible checkpoint; every indexed shard header was read at a pinned original-preview revision.

license.note: Exact model card explicitly applies MIT to the repository and model weights; license text accessed.

parameters_b.note: Complete logical checkpoint count is 1598837347742: 1572.997201763B main plus 25.840145979B unique MTP. Expands packed FP4 weights two per byte; excludes quantization scales and fixed routing indices while retaining learned mHC scales and parameterized router weights/biases. Shared main embedding/head counted once. The advertised 1.6T is rounded and cannot resolve main-versus-complete scope by itself.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal activation per token of the main model, not an exact tensor-derived count or combined main-plus-MTP compute. The main has top-6 routed experts plus one shared expert per layer; separate MTP adds parameters and prediction work.

architecture.note: Decoder Transformer with DeepSeekMoE, hybrid Compressed Sparse Attention/Heavily Compressed Attention and manifold-constrained hyper-connections. 61 main blocks with 384 routed experts/top-6 and one shared expert, plus one MTP block; first three main blocks use hash routing.

context_window.note: Preserves advertised one-million-token context. Checkpoint max_position_embeddings is 1048576; this configured positional ceiling is distinct from the decimal advertised window.

modalities.note: Causal text language-model configuration, token embedding/output head, complete checkpoint structure and text encoder establish text input/output; the preview report places multimodal capabilities in future work.

reasoning.note: Original release supports Thinking and Non-Thinking; exact card details Non-think, Think High and Think Max, with explicit thinking blocks in the encoder.

tool_call.note: Original checkpoint encoder explicitly supports tool schemas, DSML tool calls and tool responses; original card reports tool-use evaluations.

description.value: April 2026 DeepSeek-V4 preview: open-weight text MoE with hybrid compressed attention, million-token context, reasoning modes and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces promotional flagship wording and clarifies the historical preview so it cannot be mistaken for the current August API target.

patch.notes: April 24, 2026 preview checkpoint. Complete logical weights total 1598.837347742B: 1572.997201763B main plus 25.840145979B unique MTP; packed FP4 weights expanded, quantization scales/fixed routing indices excluded, shared embedding/head counted once. Official 1.6T is nominal; official 49B active describes main-model activation, not additional MTP work. Advertised context is 1M, while configured positional ceiling is 1048576. Current API alias deepseek-v4-pro maps to the later DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813; this record preserves the original preview linked by its baseline date and checkpoint. No endpoint execution was tested.

summary: Independently verified all 14 fields for the original April preview. Adds MIT, MoE architecture, complete 1598.837347742B logical parameters and nominal 49B main-model active count. All 64 tensor headers reconcile the MTP attachment, FP4 packing and metadata exclusions. Keeps advertised 1M distinct from 1048576 configured positions, preserves text/reasoning/tool support and documents the later 0813 API alias identity conflict.
